title: Make Docker Compose runnable

context.summary: Replace API/MCP/worker Compose placeholders with real built application commands and a migration startup path.
context.background: TASK-25 completed Hermes runtime integration. The MVP now needs a local Docker Compose deployment that can build the monorepo, migrate PostgreSQL and start API, worker and MCP services.

in: Add a root Dockerfile that installs locked dependencies and builds TypeScript workspaces.
Add a migrate service that runs the Drizzle migration before app services.
Run API, worker and MCP services with real dist entrypoints.
Add healthchecks and local object storage volumes.
Keep optional profile services for MinIO, ClamAV, Qdrant, Docling and Ollama.
Update Compose validation and deployment docs.
out: Publish production images to a registry.
Add Kubernetes or Helm deployment artifacts.
Make MCP stdio a network daemon.
Run the full live E2E acceptance scenario.

acceptance_criteria: Dockerfile builds the workspace from pnpm-lock.yaml and emits dist outputs.
Compose defines migrate, api, worker and mcp services using the built image.
API starts with apps/api/dist/server.js and checks /ready.
MCP starts with apps/mcp/dist/stdio.js and keeps stdin open.
API and worker mount the local object storage volume.
App services wait for PostgreSQL/Redis and the migration service.
.env.example and docs describe the local MVP Compose path.

manual_checks: Confirm API/MCP/worker placeholder commands were removed.
Confirm local storage volume is mounted by API and worker.
Confirm migrate runs before API and worker.

risks: Building the image requires network access for first-time dependency downloads unless the Docker cache is warm.
MCP stdio is not a network service; Compose keeps stdin open for local process attachment.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch can be merged into master without unrelated changes.
